name: application-button-groups
title: Button Groups
description: Responsive button group components for web applications, dashboards, and admin panels with action buttons, icon buttons, tabbed navigation, and toggle controls.
useWhen: Responsive button group components for web applications, dashboards, and admin panels with action buttons, icon buttons, tabbed navigation, and toggle controls.
avoidWhen: Avoid button groups when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Button Groups uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Keep semantic HTML structure and visible text labels when adapting this component.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
